description:
Preview for Messenger 580.0.0.49.91 (arm64, version code 346013387).

- The install-beside-Meta patch now checks the exact guarded components and six DEX instruction sites as it renames the two shared permissions.
- The build uses locked, hash-verified dependencies and produces the same bundle checksum from clean builds.
- Added nine regression tests and clearer preview source instructions.

The bundle patched a copy of the stock APK off-device. Its output passed Android v3 signature verification. Login, calls, notifications and Facebook sign-on still need a signed-in phone check. Keep your Messenger secure-storage recovery method and signing key before replacing an installed copy.
